widgetTool.name: show_claim_status_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a rebate claim progress tracker card on chat with the steps Received, Reviewing, Approved and Paid. Use it after start_rebate_claim or get_rebate_claim_status when the caller is on chat. Pass the card field of the tool as is. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-claim-status-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-claim-status-card (the card element this tool renders).

state.description: One of done, current or todo.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Say the claim number and the current step in one short sentence, and mention the usual timeframe from the note.
